lines.en: A puff of black smoke passes by!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的眼眸闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: Cold glint in its dark eyes.

lines.zh: 扭曲的影子在地面游走。
lines.en: Distorted shadow skitters on the ground.

lines.zh: 黑暗的魔力在空气中弥漫。
lines.en: Dark magic hangs in the air.

lines.zh: 黑袍拖地，声音像漏风的炉。
lines.en: My robe drags; my breath hisses like a leaky furnace.
Decaying stench wafts on the breeze.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的低语渐渐清晰。
幽暗的光芒如鬼火般闪烁。
lines.en: Flickering ghostly light in the darkness.
Violet-black wings slide along the stone hall.
A trail of rot follows behind me.
It stands quietly in the shadow.

lines.zh: 它的形体在黑暗中隐现。
lines.en: Its form flickers in the dark.

lines.zh: 凝视着玩家，它的眼睛在闪烁。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam as it stares at you.

lines.zh: 它低垂着头颅，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Its head hangs as if in thought.

lines.zh: 它轻声呢喃，似乎在念咒。
lines.en: It murmurs softly, as if casting a spell.

lines.zh: 它的触手在空气中轻轻舞动。
lines.en: Its tentacles flutter in the air.

lines.zh: 黑暗中它仿佛融入了背景。
lines.en: It seems to blend into the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在漆黑中显得格外明亮。
lines.en: Its eyes glow bright in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它静静地站在那里，等待时机。
lines.en: It stands still, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 它的轮廓在阴影中若隐若现。
lines.en: Its outline flickers in and out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 指间悬着一团暗紫的咒。
lines.en: A dark violet spell hangs between my fingers.
Vague words murmur at my lips.
I am gathering the next shot.
My violet skin rises and falls slightly.
I wait for the spell to cool.

lines.zh: 你的存在引起了它的注意。
我的目光一落到你身上，你就反胃。
lines.en: One look from me and your stomach turns.

lines.zh: 你被它的眼神吸引住了。
它的尖利目光让你感到不安。
它的视线在你身上停留。
你被它的邪恶目光震慑。
lines.en: You are震慑 by its evil gaze.

lines.zh: 它的目光如利剑穿透你。
lines.en: Its gaze pierces you like a sword.
My spell is aimed at your stomach.
One hit from me and you retch for ten seconds.

lines.zh: 看到食物就忍不住要吞噬！

lines.en: Violet light spills from my wingtips.

lines.zh: 找到合适的配偶很重要！

lines.en: Find a mate, form an alliance.

lines.zh: 黑暗中闪烁着它的红眼。
lines.en: Its red eyes glow in the dark.

lines.zh: 一缕幽光缠绕着它的身体。
lines.en: A faint glow wraps around its body.

lines.zh: 它尖锐的牙齿反射出寒光。
你闻到一股腐烂的味道。
lines.en: You smell a stench of decay.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在黑暗中划出痕迹。
lines.en: Its claws carve through the darkness.

lines.zh: 你看到它体内的魔法波动。
lines.en: You see magical fluctuations inside it.

lines.zh: 它发出嘶嘶声，似乎在思考。
它的皮肤呈现出诡异的紫色。
lines.en: Its skin has an eerie purple hue.

lines.zh: 它的魔法力量正在凝聚。
你的心脏，已经被我数过三遍。
lines.en: Your heart has been counted by me three times.

lines.zh: 梦魇里的坐标，只指向你。
lines.en: The coordinates in the nightmare point only at you.
You are locked in its gaze.
Its magic is about to erupt.
I have levelled my spell at you.
Three bursts of pain. Can you take it?

lines.zh: 你的动作引起它的注意。
我举起法杖，子弹先于咒语。
lines.en: My staff rises; bullets come before the spell.
It is ready to cast a spell.

lines.zh: 它的魔法之力即将爆发。
lines.en: Its magical power is about to erupt.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的魔力波动。
它的瞄准让你心生恐惧。
lines.en: Its aim fills you with fear.

lines.zh: 它的力量在你身上聚焦。

lines.en: Its sight is only on you.
Its magic is about to be released.
The first shot is only a test.
The spark has fastened onto you.
You will not dodge the second burst.

lines.zh: 这一击带着暮光的反胃感。
lines.en: This blow carries the Twilight's nausea.
The rot-spell is loaded and pours into you!
Twilight falls, and the light is mine.
I squeeze out of a twilight rift.
I take shape inside violet smoke.
Chanting drifts from deep in the stone hall.
After dusk, I take my place.
I fell from a great height.

lines.zh: 我被爆炸的冲击波击中。
魔法之箭贯穿了我的身体。
我的子弹，一段接着一段。
lines.en: My bullets come one segment after another.

lines.zh: 我的黑袍被虚空一寸寸撕走。
lines.en: The void strips my black robe inch by inch.
